fix: `ConvexCone.gi.gc.isGLB_l.sInf_eq` (Geometry/Convex/Cone/Basic.lean:722). `toCone_eq_sInf` states `hs.toCone s = sInf {t | s ⊆ t}`. With `ConvexCone.gi : GaloisInsertion (hull R) (↑)`, `GaloisConnection.isGLB_l : IsGLB {b | a ≤ u b} (l a)` plus `IsGLB.sInf_eq` gives `sInf {t | s ⊆ ↑t} = hull 𝕜 s`, as in the old proof `toCone_isLeast.isGLB.sInf_eq.symm`. No `GaloisConnection.isLUB_u` exists, and `sSup_eq` would be the wrong side. The sibling deprecation at :716 reads `ConvexCone.gi.gc.isLeast_l`.
